before: A load read the paragraph marks in the cells of a new row with the paragraph mark role, though compose writes them with the row's w:id. When the row came first, the suggestion's other new paragraph marks took the row's w:id after a fold.
after: A load reads an insertion marker whose suggestion also made a container it is in with the role compose writes it for (the row's), so every mark keeps its w:id live, after a fold and in the editor alone.
reason: Change messages, the change log, checkpoints and the Yjs format do not change: only the w:id the load keeps for a role changes, and compose wrote the same ids before. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
